description: Welcome to GreenVanguard ! We are participating in the "Field Shift: Adapting Farms with NASA Data" challenge. Our goal is to build an innovative decision-support tool that helps farmers adapt to climate change using NASA's Earth observation data. We are looking for passionate members with skills in software development, data analysis, UI/UX design, or agriculture. Let's collaborate and build something impactful together!
summary: AgroCycle is a mobile decision-support application designed to help farmers make more informed crop planning and rotation decisions. The app combines NASA Earth observation data, including temperature, rainfall, and solar radiation, with local soil information such as soil type, pH, moisture, and nutrient levels. Farmers can explore climate conditions, assess soil health, and receive crop recommendations through the Plant Guide. AgroCycle also supports sustainable rotation planning by helping users consider crop suitability, water availability, and long-term soil health. By bringing climate insights, soil analysis, and crop guidance into one accessible tool, AgroCycle helps farmers adapt to changing environmental conditions, conserve resources, and build more resilient farms.
details:
AgroCycle is an Android-based decision-support application designed to help farmers understand their farm conditions and make better crop planning and rotation decisions.

The application allows farmers to enter local soil information, including soil type, pH, soil moisture, nitrogen, phosphorus, and potassium levels. AgroCycle also uses NASA POWER data to provide climate information such as temperature, rainfall, and solar radiation. This climate data is combined with local soil information to help users understand their farm conditions and evaluate crop suitability.

The Plant Guide provides crop recommendations and compatibility scores based on the available soil and climate information. The application also includes farm management and crop rotation features that help farmers explore suitable crops and more sustainable farming strategies.

AgroCycle aims to help farmers adapt to changing temperatures, irregular rainfall, water shortages, and declining soil health. Its intended impact is to support better crop decisions, conserve water, improve soil health, and strengthen the long-term resilience of farms.

The application was developed for Android using Kotlin and Android Studio. NASA POWER data was used for climate-related information, including temperature, rainfall, and solar radiation. The team considered usability, accessibility, climate adaptation, soil health, water efficiency, and the practical needs of farmers.

The project is creative because it combines NASA Earth observation data, local soil analysis, climate monitoring, plant recommendations, farm management, and crop rotation support in one mobile application. This gives farmers a simple way to explore data-driven strategies for more sustainable and climate-resilient farming.

AI Disclosure: ChatGPT was used as an assistance tool during development to support Kotlin and Android code suggestions, debugging, technical explanations, and project documentation. The team reviewed, tested, modified, and adapted all AI-assisted outputs. The final design, implementation decisions, and testing were completed by the team.
